race.comment: BLIND SQUIRREL (2) has shown speed at all three of her outings. Those from a break have been much better. Has a lovely gate. PINKISH HUE (12) brings in two trials from a spell. Took on some better races than this but will have to improve. PUTINACALL (10) resumed from a spell last start and did well to finish third over 1000m at this track. Racing well and can give this a shake. MARKWELL TOPSORT (3) has run his best races at this course. Has only ever run on wet tracks where most have been solid efforts. Fitter again and drawn the widest but has good speed to overcome the gate. Can make an impact.
